findings: Bind support evidence to the captured discovery object's exact path/kind/name, not only the current map name.

Test revocation between steps and preserve already-served opportunity identity.

development_failures: Initial support test collection failed before the new module existed.
Initial 29-pass and 106-pass integration runs overlap the final suite and predate downstream context isolation.

Expanded support/learning development run: 37 passed, 2 failed. Corrected the fixture request-key pattern and supplied marks/calls arrays in synthetic ordinary records. Real learning path rerun passed 3 tests.
Advisor review exposed exact-path map rebinding and normal issue reuse risks before final validation. Both were corrected and covered by integration tests.
A closure read initially used training/READ_ME_TRAINER_NOW.md, which does not exist; reread the actual root brief. No file was created.
feature_limits: Manually pasted/minimized excerpts only; no automatic redaction, file watcher, mailbox or analytics connector.
At most 30 retained reports; no archive/delete flow. Import is unselected; duplicate content preserves its prior selection.
At most 3 newest selected reports within 12000 UTF-8 bytes of report entries per component.
Report evidence supplements existing failing-test opportunities in mapped Python src repositories. Report alone is not a repair trigger or a verification result.
Deselection/change stops subsequent steps at safe boundaries, not an already-sent call. Closed opportunity identities are not reopened.
Support-assisted sessions/checked proposals remain local review records; excluded from episodic memory, Kaizen experience/replay and trial scoring.
Local home exports include retained records. This is not a general information-flow or prompt-injection guarantee.
No field commissioning or unattended production qualification.
